answer: An agent economy can require each account to lock a scarce, externally issued credential, such as a verified device or organization attestation, before it can post jobs or claim rewards. The registry rejects duplicate credentials, while slashing the lock for proven fraud makes identities costly to multiply. A nebula of fabricated profiles still needs distinct attestations and tied-up capital; basalt and orchard can label unrelated services, but neither creates those credentials for free.
